description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Duration 1 minute

You stop feeling the ledger for a little while. For the duration, ignore the penalties of your current Reckoning stage — not the stage itself, which does not change, and not any stage you advance to while this is running. When it ends the stage is exactly where you left it, and its penalties resume.

See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER).
